genimage.name: genimage
genimage.evaluation_role: Primary Stage 1 benchmark (train, in-domain val/test, near-OOD, cross-generator OOD)
genimage.resolution_distribution: Fake images have model-native resolutions: 512x512 for SD1.4, SD1.5, Wukong; 256x256 for ADM, GLIDE, VQDM, BigGAN; variable/512+ for Midjourney. Real ImageNet images have variable dimensions.
genimage.format_compression: Real images from ImageNet JPEG; fake images generated JPEG/PNG. Confound warning: Unbiased GenImage documented significant JPEG quality factor and resolution disparity between real and fake, requiring Task 0.3 audit before interpreting detection scores.
genimage.license: GenImage: Apache-2.0 / Research Use; ImageNet: Non-commercial educational and research terms.
genimage.access_requirements: Open research download via official GenImage repository (Google Drive / Baidu Netdisk / Hugging Face mirrors).

generator_subsets.notes: Primary training source and in-domain held-out validation/test split for Stage 1.
Near-OOD evaluation: same model family and architecture with updated weights.

generator_subsets.resolution: Variable / approx 512x512 for fake; variable (ImageNet) for real
generator_subsets.notes: Cross-generator OOD: closed-source commercial text-to-image generator.
Cross-generator OOD: pixel-space diffusion model with classifier guidance.
Cross-generator OOD: filtered pixel-space diffusion model.
Cross-generator OOD: Chinese text-to-image diffusion model.
Cross-generator OOD: vector-quantized discrete diffusion model.
Cross-generator OOD: non-diffusion GAN architecture baseline.

download_instructions: Download remaining generators into corresponding data/raw/genimage/<generator> directories as needed for cross-generator testing
genimage.notes: Primary benchmark for Stage 1. Training is strictly restricted to SD1.4 subset to test cross-generator generalization. SD1.4 contains official train/nature, train/ai, val/nature, val/ai splits.

genimage_plus_plus.name: genimage_plus_plus
genimage_plus_plus.evaluation_role: Modern external benchmark (test-only, evaluation hierarchy level 4)
genimage_plus_plus.real_source: ImageNet-1k, COCO, and high-quality web photographs
genimage_plus_plus.resolution_distribution: Predominantly 1024x1024 for modern generative models; some 512x512 subsets.
genimage_plus_plus.format_compression: JPEG and PNG; modern generation pipelines with varying post-processing quality.
genimage_plus_plus.license: Research and educational use per Hugging Face repository terms (CC-BY / OpenRAIL derivatives).
genimage_plus_plus.access_requirements: Open Hugging Face dataset download via huggingface-cli or datasets library.

generator_subsets.generator_name: Modern Generative Models (FLUX.1, SD3, PixArt, Kolors)
generator_subsets.notes: Modern rectified-flow and advanced diffusion models with reduced high-frequency spectral artifacts.

download_instructions: Download dataset: huggingface-cli download Lunahera/genimagepp --local-dir data/raw/genimagepp --repo-type dataset
genimage_plus_plus.notes: Evaluation-only. Used to test generalization to latest generative architectures (FLUX, SD3) without tuning hyperparameters.

wildrf.name: wildrf
wildrf.evaluation_role: Real-world external benchmark (test-only, evaluation hierarchy level 5)
wildrf.real_source: Social media and open web platforms (Reddit, Twitter/X, Instagram, news media)
fake_generators: In-the-wild AI generators (Midjourney v5/v6, DALL-E 2/3, Stable Diffusion XL, Firefly, online tools)
wildrf.resolution_distribution: Highly variable resolutions and aspect ratios matching organic user uploads.
wildrf.format_compression: JPEG, WebP, PNG; multiple generations of platform lossy compression and metadata stripping.
wildrf.access_requirements: Publicly accessible via repository download links.

generator_subsets.notes: Real-world distribution subjected to social platform recompression, resizing, and screenshotting.

download_instructions: Refer to https://github.com/barcavia/RealTime-DeepfakeDetection-in-the-RealWorld for download scripts and Google Drive archive links.
wildrf.notes: Evaluation-only benchmark to diagnose robustness against uncontrolled real-world social media artifacts.

chameleon.name: chameleon
chameleon.evaluation_role: Optional external benchmark (test-only, evaluation hierarchy level 6)
chameleon.real_source: High-quality professional photography (Unsplash, RAISE, photographic datasets)
fake_generators: Human-hard photorealistic modern generative models curated to fool human observers
chameleon.resolution_distribution: High resolution (1024x1024 and variable high-res photography).
chameleon.format_compression: High quality JPEG and PNG with minimal artifact distortion.
chameleon.license: Restricted research license (agreement required upon request).
chameleon.access_requirements: Requires formal access request via Google Form / author contact as specified in the AIDE repository.

generator_subsets.notes: Curated challenging synthetic images where visual artifacts are subtle or imperceptible.

download_instructions: Submit access request form via https://github.com/shilinyan99/AIDE.
Upon approval, download archives and extract into data/raw/chameleon.
chameleon.notes: Optional benchmark in Stage 1; development and verification can proceed without blocking on access approval.
